cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded FBB StyleUp card rewarding fashion purchases, shopping vouchers, and lifestyle perks for FBB customers.

benefitRows.name: FBB
benefitRows.offer: When you shop for Fashion Clothing, Accessories, Backpacks, Footwear, and School Bags at Fbb Shops, you will receive a 10% upfront discount all year.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Avail over and above the existing offers in the store (Big Bazaar & fbb).
